extracted.name: Savory Spanish Potato Salad
extracted.description: This Spanish-style potato salad includes red potatoes, bell pepper, and olives tossed in an olive oil-based dressing for a crowd-pleasing side.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Place potatoes into a pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes. Drain and cool until easily handled. Slice potatoes about 1/2-inch thick and place in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil and vinegar together in a bowl; stir in garlic. Pour dressing over potatoes and lightly toss to coat.
Mix red bell pepper, green olives, shallot, parsley, salt, and pepper into potatoes. Serve salad with lemon wedges to squeeze over each serving.
